name: HelpShelf
author: helpshelf

sections.description:
The HelpShelf WordPress Plugin provides a customizable widget service that integrates seamlessly with your WordPress site. This plugin acts as a connector to the HelpShelf service, enabling you to embed a fully customizable help widget on your website.

Key Features:
* Dynamic Script Insertion:
The plugin takes the SITE_ID provided by the user in the WordPress admin panel and automatically injects the required JavaScript code into the section of all pages.
* HelpShelf Widget Integration:
The plugin loads a JavaScript file from a dynamic URL (https://s3.amazonaws.com/helpshelf-production/gen/loader/{SITE_ID}.min.js) hosted on our secure S3 service. This file initializes and identifies the HelpShelf widget, ensuring that any updates or bug fixes are delivered instantly without requiring a new plugin release.
* Customizable User and Company Attributes:
Easily pass custom attributes to HelpShelf for personalized user interactions and enhanced support.

Service Information:
* This plugin connects to HelpShelf’s widget service
* The remote script loading is essential for widget functionality because:
– It enables real-time widget customization
– Allows dynamic updates to widget appearance and behavior
– Maintains consistent widget performance across all installations
* A HelpShelf account is required (sign up at https://helpshelf.com)
* Your site will connect to our secure AWS S3 servers (helpshelf-production.s3.amazonaws.com) to load the widget

Widget Customization:
* Fully customizable design to match your brand
* Flexible color scheme options
* Adjustable widget positioning and behavior
* Custom styling options through HelpShelf dashboard

*Technical Details:**
* Remote Script: The plugin loads your customized widget configuration from our secure servers
* Server Location: All widget resources are served from helpshelf-production.s3.amazonaws.com
* Updates: Remote loading ensures your widget always has the latest features and improvements

Account Requirements:
1. Sign up for a HelpShelf account at https://helpshelf.com
2. Obtain your unique SITE_KEY from the HelpShelf dashboard
3. Enter the SITE_KEY in your WordPress plugin settings
4. Customize your widget design through the HelpShelf

Privacy & Security:
* All remote scripts are served via HTTPS
* Our servers are hosted on secure AWS infrastructure
* Widget configuration is loaded securely

Additional Information

By integrating HelpShelf, you agree to allow our plugin to load remote assets essential for delivering our service. For more details on our service and remote asset management, please visit https://helpshelf.com/.
sections.installation:
1. Download the plugin ZIP file.
  2. Navigate to the Plugins section in your WordPress dashboard.
  3. Click “Add New” and then “Upload Plugin.”
  4. Select the ZIP file you downloaded and click “Install Now.”
  5. After installation, click “Activate” to enable the plugin.
sections.faq:
Q: Why is the HelpShelf JavaScript file loaded from an external server?

A: Because HelpShelf is designed as a service, our dynamic assets are hosted on our secure S3 service. This allows us to quickly deploy updates and maintain compatibility without forcing frequent plugin updates.

  • Initial release featuring core AI-powered search functionality, dynamic script insertion, and remote asset management for the HelpShelf widget.
